'''Jek''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] he was tasked with protecting the senate as well as escort duty. Until he and a [[Rys/Legends|fellow Trooper]] under the command of [[Thire/Legends|Lieutenant Thire]] went with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on his [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|Mission to Rugosa]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jek. Concerned about weapons you are. Weapons do not win battles. Your mind, powerful it is! Mmm? Outthink the droids you can.|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to Jek|audio=YodaJek.flac|<ref name="Ambush" />}}
[[File:JekBigGun-Ambush.png|thumb|left|250px|Jek on Rugosa]]
At the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jek had a relatively uneventful posting in the Senate district. Probably because of the sedate confines of Senate and diplomatic escort duty Jek became obsessed with weapons as an outlet. He was an expert in all manner of small arms blaster weaponry, and had even gone so far as requisitioning and obtaining heavy weapons even though they weren't part of his mission requirements.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Jek finally got the chance to test some of his favorite weapons in action when he and his fellow trooper [[Rys/Legends|Rys]] under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Thire/Legends|Thire]] were assigned to escort [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to a diplomatic mission to [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]]. When their transport came under attack by Separatist frigates, Yoda and the troopers landed on the moon's surface in the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The clones helped Yoda to get past a whole battalion of [[T81 Division]]'s [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] along with [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], sent by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to intercept them as a challenge to the competency of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] forces, in order to secure a treaty with [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. During the mission, Yoda advised Jek that his most powerful weapon was not the hardware that he lugged around, but his mind. The lesson stuck with Jek, who along with his fellow clones was able to improvise a critical rescue when Yoda was outnumbered by approaching [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] by shooting a rocky overhang, making it collapse on the droidekas, which allowed them to successfully complete their mission.

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Jek-TCW.png|thumb|right|180px|Jek, in full armor, minus his helmet]]
A loyal yet laconic clone trooper, Jek preferred to let his Z-6 rotary blaster do the talking. Jek used his weapons as an outlet, due to the quiet confines of Senate and diplomatic escort duty. Yoda advised Jek that his most powerful weapon was his mind, and not the hardware that he lugged around, a lesson that struck a chord with the clone.<ref name="Databank" /> Jek had a shaved head not unlike many of his clone brothers, and he also had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on the back of his neck.<ref name="Prelude">''[[The Clone Wars: Prelude]]''</ref> He appeared to be good friends with Rys.

==Equipment==
Jek's main weapon was a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]]. He also favoured a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], thermal detonators, and many more weapons. Jek bore the markings of the Coruscant guard on his helmet, arms, and kneepads.

==Behind the scenes==
The closed captions for "[[Ambush]]," the novel adaption ''[[The Clone Wars: Yoda in Action!|Yoda In Action!]]'' by [[Dorling Kindersley|DK Readers]], and the comic adaption ''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]'' use the alternate spelling "Jjeck."
